screen1.title: LOOK UP.
screen1.subtitle: THE ALARM IS NOT THE DANGER.
screen1.detail: A feeling can be loud without telling you the whole story.

screen2.subtitle: Tap a phrase to observe how the detector reacts.
screen2.example3: “What if I can’t be completely sure?”

screen3.title: THAT FEELING CAN BE LOUD.
screen3.subtitle: The feeling is real. The message it seems to carry isn’t automatically the whole story.

screen4.title: LOOK CLOSER.
screen4.subtitle: Drag anywhere to inspect the detector from any angle.
screen4.detail: You can notice the signal without immediately rushing to a conclusion.

screen5.title: SIGNAL ≠ VERDICT
screen5.subtitle: A strong feeling can be real without automatically proving what it seems to say.

screen6.title: SOMETIMES A RESPONSE CAN QUIET THE SIGNAL FOR A MOMENT.
screen6.subtitle: Tap to see how responses interact with the signal.
screen6.item_replay_quote: “I’ll go over it again in my head.”
screen6.item_avoid_quote: “I’ll stay away from whatever feels uncertain.”

screen7.title: LET THE SIGNAL BE THERE.
screen7.subtitle: Notice what happens when you don't immediately rush to interpret it.
screen7.done_sub: You didn't have to solve it.

screen8.subtitle: Notice the feeling. Notice the story your mind adds to it.
screen8.question: NEXT TIME THE ALARM GETS LOUD, WHAT MIGHT YOU NOTICE FIRST?
